main_body: A pew seen from the side (east/west facing): a tall plank backrest on the left and a seat with a red cushion panel on the right. The cushion is drawn face-on as a vertical red panel.
top_band: No real top band. In the seat column the first rows are a 2-row light brown rim (rows 14-15, L=124). Below it is a flat red panel (rows 16-25), which is a vertical face. The seat's horizontal surface is not visible from above.
evidence: The pew is drawn as a side profile: a tall backrest strip on the left and a panel with two red cushion fields on the right. The only light band on top is a 2px rim (rows 14-15), which is too thin to read as a surface. The red areas are vertical panels, not a seat seen from above. The bottom seat rows (40-45) read as a front lip, not as a top. This matches the red side elevation chair in the guide, so it fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and 8 colours per tile, against 38-40 distinct colours and 17-20 per tile in the references. The red panels are large flat fills with no grain or dots, and the wood is flat too, with 22% flat-fill coverage against 0-13% in the references. The outline is a tinted dark brown (2% neutral), which is good, but shading depth and texture are clearly thinner than the references.
